kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Upper band Rs 245 (49,02,000 fresh shares, Rs 120.10 cr). At Rs 245: market cap Rs 400.3 cr post-issue; P/E 13.7x on FY26 PAT (9.6x pre-issue; 8.4x on the company's EPS of Rs 29.13); P/B about 2.0x post-issue; EV/EBITDA about 6.9x. One usable RHP peer P/E 16.1x. Objects floor Rs 213.

focus.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
focus.detail: FY26 EPS Rs 29.13 and NAV Rs 85.47 both imply about 1.001 crore shares (PAT 29.16 / 29.13; net worth 85.55 / 85.47), but pre-issue shares are 1.14385 crore (pre-IPO market cap Rs 280.24 cr / Rs 245). About 13.4 lakh shares were therefore added after Mar-2026; trackers report no pre-IPO placement, so the source (allotment, bonus or conversion) and price need the RHP.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported P/E is a fair measure: the adjustments found move FY26 PAT by +0.0%, within the 10% threshold. On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 16.8x reported and 16.8x adjusted.
checked: Profit growth (+19%) tracks revenue growth (+18%) in FY26; no step-change to explain

Depreciation policy (useful lives of forklifts and AWPs), gains on resale of used equipment within revenue, and cash tax could not be tested without the RHP; equipment-sale income inside revenue would flatter recurring rental earnings
